newsitem.title: USA: Michigan unemployment up 0.1 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Michigan unemployment up 0.1 pct in April.

text.p: Michigan's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose 0.1 percent in April to 4.4 percent due to production adjustment layoffs in the manufacturing sector, the Michigan Employment Security Agency reported Wednesday.
The Michigan economy remains strong overall with employment up 111,000 compared to April 1996 when the unemployment rate stood at 4.9 percent, the agency reported.
The agency's monthly employer payroll survey found a slight drop in wage and salary employment in April, director Thomas Malek reported.
Manufacturing posted the largest decline in wage and salary employment, with smaller losses noted in retail trade and government sectors, the agency reported.
The Michigan jobless rate remained below the national rate for the 25th straight month, the agency reported. The national rate had dropped from 5.2 percent in March to 4.9 percent in April.
